mapper.sql: ST_XMin(${a}.geom) AS minx, ST_YMin(${a}.geom) AS miny, ST_XMax(${a}.geom) AS maxx, ST_YMax(${a}.geom) AS maxy, ST_X(coalesce(${a}.centroid, theme.inner_point(${a}.geom))) AS cx, ST_Y(coalesce(${a}.centroid, theme.inner_point(${a}.geom))) AS cy, ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_SimplifyPreserveTopology(${a}.geom, ${tol}), 6)::text AS geojson

ST_XMin(${a}.geom) AS minx, ST_YMin(${a}.geom) AS miny, ST_XMax(${a}.geom) AS maxx, ST_YMax(${a}.geom) AS maxy, ST_X(theme.inner_point(${a}.geom)) AS cx, ST_Y(theme.inner_point(${a}.geom)) AS cy, ST_AsGeoJSON(${a}.geom, 7)::text AS geojson

choose.when: SELECT 'AD' AS key, 'Emirate of Abu Dhabi' AS name, 'إمارة أبوظبي' AS name_ar, ST_XMin(e) AS minx, ST_YMin(e) AS miny, ST_XMax(e) AS maxx, ST_YMax(e) AS maxy, ST_X(ST_Centroid(e)) AS cx, ST_Y(ST_Centroid(e)) AS cy, NULL AS geojson, (SELECT round(sum(area_km2), 1) FROM theme.sp_municipality) AS area_km2 FROM (SELECT ST_Extent(geom)::geometry AS e FROM theme.sp_district) x

SELECT m.municipality_code AS key, m.name_en AS name, m.name_ar, m.municipality_code, m.municipality_id, m.area_km2,
FROM theme.sp_municipality m WHERE m.municipality_code = #{key}

SELECT d.district_key AS key, d.name_en AS name, d.name_ar, d.municipality_code, m.name_en AS municipality_name, d.district_id, d.popular_name_en, d.population, d.area_km2,
FROM theme.sp_district d LEFT JOIN theme.sp_municipality m ON m.municipality_code = d.municipality_code WHERE d.district_key = #{key}

SELECT c.community_key AS key, AS name, c.name_ar, c.municipality_code, m.name_en AS municipality_name, c.district_key, d.name_en AS district_name, c.community_id, c.popular_name_en, c.composite_name_en, c.area_km2,
FROM theme.sp_community c LEFT JOIN theme.sp_district d ON d.district_key = c.district_key LEFT JOIN theme.sp_municipality m ON m.municipality_code = c.municipality_code WHERE c.community_key = #{key}

SELECT p.plot_key AS key, AS name, NULL AS name_ar, p.municipality_code, m.name_en AS municipality_name, p.district_key, d.name_en AS district_name, p.community_key, AS community_name, p.gisid, p.plot_id, p.plot_number, p.elms_plot_id, p.area_sqm, p.planned_area_sqm, p.construction_status, p.service_status, p.planning_status, p.plot_status, p.primary_use, p.parent_land_use, p.land_use, p.secondary_use, p.ownership_type, p.allocation_status, p.investment_name, p.devcode, p.devcode_category, p.devcode_far, p.devcode_max_gfa, p.max_heights, p.zone_tpss, p.sector_tpss, p.project_id, p.permit_last_type, p.permit_last_date::date AS permit_last_date, p.cancel_date::date AS cancel_date, p.src_district_en, p.src_community_en, p.modified_date::date AS modified_date,
FROM theme.sp_plot p LEFT JOIN theme.sp_community c ON c.community_key = p.community_key LEFT JOIN theme.sp_district d ON d.district_key = p.district_key LEFT JOIN theme.sp_municipality m ON m.municipality_code = p.municipality_code WHERE p.plot_key = #{key}

SELECT b.building_key AS key, AS name, b.name_ar, b.municipality_code, m.name_en AS municipality_name, b.district_key, d.name_en AS district_name, b.community_key, AS community_name, b.plot_key, AS plot_name, b.source, b.building_id, b.building_internal_id, b.bdms_building_id, b.gisid, b.physical_status, b.primary_usage_type, b.primary_use, b.secondary_usage_type, b.floors_count, b.height_m, b.completion_date::date AS completion_date, b.demolition_date::date AS demolition_date, b.start_date::date AS start_date, b.permit_id, b.construction_site_id, b.is_bdms, b.bdms_floors, b.bdms_units, round(ST_Area(b.geom::geography)::numeric, 1) AS footprint_sqm,
FROM theme.sp_building b LEFT JOIN theme.sp_plot p ON p.plot_key = b.plot_key LEFT JOIN theme.sp_community c ON c.community_key = b.community_key LEFT JOIN theme.sp_district d ON d.district_key = b.district_key LEFT JOIN theme.sp_municipality m ON m.municipality_code = b.municipality_code WHERE b.building_key = #{key}

SELECT f.floor_key AS key, AS name, NULL AS name_ar, f.municipality_code, m.name_en AS municipality_name, f.district_key, d.name_en AS district_name, f.community_key, AS community_name, f.plot_key, AS plot_name, f.building_key, AS building_name, f.source, f.floor_id, f.bdms_building_id, f.floor_number, f.floor_seq, f.base_height_m, f.floor_height_m, f.area_sqm, f.building_status, f.plot_primary_use, (SELECT count(*) FROM theme.sp_floor x WHERE x.building_key = f.building_key) AS building_floors,
FROM theme.sp_floor f LEFT JOIN theme.sp_building b ON b.building_key = f.building_key LEFT JOIN theme.sp_plot p ON p.plot_key = f.plot_key LEFT JOIN theme.sp_community c ON c.community_key = f.community_key LEFT JOIN theme.sp_district d ON d.district_key = f.district_key LEFT JOIN theme.sp_municipality m ON m.municipality_code = f.municipality_code WHERE f.floor_key = #{key}

SELECT u.unit_key AS key, AS name, NULL AS name_ar, u.municipality_code, m.name_en AS municipality_name, u.district_key, d.name_en AS district_name, u.community_key, AS community_name, u.plot_key, AS plot_name, u.building_key, AS building_name, u.floor_key, AS floor_name, u.unit_id, u.unit_number, u.unit_type, u.usage_type, u.classification, u.category, u.area_sqm, u.bedrooms, u.bathrooms, u.balcony_area_sqm, u.floor_number, u.base_height_m, u.floor_height_m, u.building_status,
FROM theme.sp_unit u LEFT JOIN theme.sp_floor f ON f.floor_key = u.floor_key LEFT JOIN theme.sp_building b ON b.building_key = u.building_key LEFT JOIN theme.sp_plot p ON p.plot_key = u.plot_key LEFT JOIN theme.sp_community c ON c.community_key = u.community_key LEFT JOIN theme.sp_district d ON d.district_key = u.district_key LEFT JOIN theme.sp_municipality m ON m.municipality_code = u.municipality_code WHERE u.unit_key = #{key}

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM theme.sp_municipality) AS municipalities, (SELECT count(*) FROM theme.sp_district) AS districts, sum(communities) AS communities, sum(plots) AS plots, sum(plots_constructed) AS plots_constructed, sum(plots_under_construction) AS plots_under_construction, sum(plots_not_constructed) AS plots_not_constructed, sum(plots_area_sqm) AS plots_area_sqm, sum(buildings) AS buildings, sum(buildings_under_construction) AS buildings_under_construction, sum(floors) AS floors, sum(units) AS units, sum(units_area_sqm) AS units_area_sqm, sum(units_area_outliers) AS units_area_outliers, sum(floors_area_sqm) AS floors_area_sqm, sum(plots_max_gfa_sqm) AS plots_max_gfa_sqm, sum(buildings_completed) AS buildings_completed, sum(buildings_demolished) AS buildings_demolished, max(last_completion_date) AS last_completion_date, max(last_demolition_date) AS last_demolition_date FROM theme.sp_node_stat WHERE level = 'municipality'
choose.otherwise: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM theme.sp_district WHERE municipality_code = #{key}) AS districts, s.communities, s.plots, s.plots_constructed, s.plots_under_construction, s.plots_not_constructed, s.plots_area_sqm, s.buildings, s.buildings_under_construction, s.floors, s.units, s.units_area_sqm, s.units_area_outliers, s.floors_area_sqm, s.plots_max_gfa_sqm, s.buildings_completed, s.buildings_demolished, s.last_completion_date, s.last_demolition_date FROM (SELECT 1) one LEFT JOIN theme.sp_node_stat s ON s.level = #{level} AND s.node_key = #{key}

choose.when: FROM theme.sp_municipality x LEFT JOIN theme.sp_node_stat s ON s.level = 'municipality' AND s.node_key = x.municipality_code WHERE 1 = 1 AND (x.name_en ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR x.municipality_code ILIKE #{q})

FROM theme.sp_district x LEFT JOIN theme.sp_node_stat s ON s.level = 'district' AND s.node_key = x.district_key WHERE x.${col} = #{key} AND (x.name_en ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR x.name_ar ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%')

FROM theme.sp_community x LEFT JOIN theme.sp_node_stat s ON s.level = 'community' AND s.node_key = x.community_key WHERE x.${col} = #{key} AND (x.name_en ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR x.composite_name_en ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR x.community_id = #{q})

FROM theme.sp_plot x LEFT JOIN theme.sp_node_stat s ON s.level = 'plot' AND s.node_key = x.plot_key WHERE x.${col} = #{key} AND x.cancel_date IS NULL AND (x.plot_number ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR x.gisid = #{q} OR x.plot_id = #{q})

mapper.select:
SELECT x.municipality_code AS "key", x.name_en AS "name", x.municipality_code AS "sub", x.area_km2 AS "areaKm2", (SELECT count(*) FROM theme.sp_district d WHERE d.municipality_code = x.municipality_code) AS "districts", s.communities AS "communities", s.plots AS "plots", s.buildings AS "buildings", s.units AS "units"
SELECT x.district_key AS "key", x.name_en AS "name", x.name_ar AS "sub", x.area_km2 AS "areaKm2", x.population AS "population", s.communities AS "communities", s.plots AS "plots", s.plots_constructed AS "plotsConstructed", s.buildings AS "buildings", s.units AS "units"
SELECT x.community_key AS "key", AS "name", x.composite_name_en AS "sub", x.area_km2 AS "areaKm2", s.plots AS "plots", s.plots_constructed AS "plotsConstructed", s.buildings AS "buildings", s.units AS "units"
SELECT x.plot_key AS "key", AS "name", x.primary_use AS "sub", x.area_sqm AS "areaSqm", x.construction_status AS "status", x.primary_use AS "use", s.buildings AS "buildings", s.units AS "units"
SELECT x.building_key AS "key", AS "name", x.primary_use AS "sub", x.physical_status AS "status", x.source AS "source", x.floors_count AS "floorsCount", x.bdms_floors AS "floors", x.bdms_units AS "units", x.height_m AS "heightM"
SELECT x.floor_key AS "key", AS "name", x.source AS "sub", x.floor_seq AS "seq", x.base_height_m AS "baseHeightM", x.floor_height_m AS "floorHeightM", x.area_sqm AS "areaSqm", (SELECT count(*) FROM theme.sp_unit u WHERE u.floor_key = x.floor_key) AS "units"
SELECT x.unit_key AS "key", AS "name", x.classification AS "sub", x.unit_type AS "type", x.area_sqm AS "areaSqm", x.bedrooms AS "bedrooms", x.bathrooms AS "bathrooms", x.floor_key AS "floorKey"
ORDER BY
x.floor_seq NULLS LAST x.base_height_m NULLS LAST, x.unit_number x.plot_number x.bdms_units DESC NULLS LAST, x.height_m DESC NULLS LAST 2
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT ${dimExpr} AS "k", count(*) AS "n", round(coalesce(sum(${areaExpr}), 0)::numeric, 1) AS "area" FROM theme.${table} x WHERE ${extra} AND x.${col} = #{key} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 24

(SELECT 'district' AS "level", district_key AS "key", name_en AS "name", municipality_code AS "sub" FROM theme.sp_district WHERE name_en ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR name_ar ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' ORDER BY name_en LIMIT #{limit}) UNION ALL (SELECT 'community', c.community_key, , d.name_en FROM theme.sp_community c LEFT JOIN theme.sp_district d ON d.district_key = c.district_key WHERE c.name_en ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR c.composite_name_en ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' ORDER BY c.name_en LIMIT #{limit}) UNION ALL (SELECT 'plot', p.plot_key, , d.name_en FROM theme.sp_plot p LEFT JOIN theme.sp_district d ON d.district_key = p.district_key WHERE p.gisid = #{q} OR p.plot_id = #{q} OR p.plot_number = #{q} LIMIT #{limit}) UNION ALL (SELECT 'building', b.building_key, , d.name_en FROM theme.sp_building b LEFT JOIN theme.sp_district d ON d.district_key = b.district_key WHERE b.building_id = #{q} OR b.building_internal_id::text = #{q} OR b.bdms_building_id::text = #{q} OR (length(#{q}) >= 3 AND b.name_en ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%') LIMIT #{limit})

SELECT table_name AS "table", theme AS "theme", title_zh AS "title", source_tables AS "sources", extractor AS "extractor", note AS "note", row_count AS "rows", source_as_of AS "asOf", loaded_at AS "loadedAt" FROM theme.meta_table ORDER BY sort_no

SELECT DISTINCT ON (source) source AS "source", status AS "status", started_at AS "startedAt", finished_at AS "finishedAt", row_count AS "rows", source_as_of AS "asOf", message AS "message" FROM stat.etl_job_log WHERE source LIKE #{prefix} || '%' ORDER BY source, started_at DESC
